citations.finding: IS03688 states that $100 million was approved in the 2023–2026 Capital Budget for the programme. Reviewer arithmetic using that base: $100.0m − $50.0m = $50.0m remaining; $100.0m − ($33.65m + $33.65m) = $32.7m remaining. Reductions are 50% and 67.3% of the base, respectively.
citations.establishes: The stated approved total used for the calculations is $100 million; the first motion meets the primary remainder band and the second does not. Both meet the alternative half-or-more reduction rule.

items.title: REPLACEMENT Attachment 3 - IS03688 - Locations and Status Updates

citations.finding: Attachment 3 (and its replacement), dated 'as of August 10, 2026', shows none of the 14 listed routes under construction. Three are tendered but not started, six are no longer viable for 2026 installation, and five have no delivery plan or schedule.
citations.establishes: All 14 listed routes were unbuilt at the primary status date.
citations.quote: While they can be tendered, their installation in 2026 is no longer viable.

citations.finding: As of August 10, Attachment 3 records three listed-apart routes as tendered but not started; six originally scheduled for 2026 as no longer viable for installation that year; and five without a delivery plan and schedule, including the paused southern 50 Street segment. None is recorded as under construction or complete.
citations.establishes: The August 10 construction status of all 14 listed-apart entries.

items.title: REPLACEMENT (Version 2) Attachment 5 - IS03688 - Modified Approach for Active Transportation Network Expansion Program

citations.finding: Under Version 2 of Attachment 5, the declared primary version, the recommended treatment of the 14 routes listed apart is evaluation plus a Q1 2027 report to Council. The text does not say those routes wait for that step, so what went undecided was not a hold under the primary deferral definition.
citations.establishes: What administration proposed under the primary version.
citations.quote: The remaining routes will be evaluated for trade-offs, alternative design treatments and budget implications. In Q1 2027, Administration will bring forward a report ... for Council direction and approval.

citations.finding: Version 2, the declared primary, drops the 'evaluated to determine if they should proceed' rule and the removal language. It prescribes evaluation and a Q1 2027 report, and says the listed projects 'may be re-evaluated using alternate design approaches'. It does not state that they wait for that step.
citations.establishes: The express-deferral element is not met under the primary version.
citations.quote: If Council approves the approach, the following projects may be re-evaluated using alternate design approaches.

citations.finding: Version 2 distinguishes 13 projects that continue as planned from 14 that may be re-evaluated, with a Q1 2027 report for Council direction and approval. It does not expressly state that all 14 are held from construction or advancement until that report or decision.
citations.establishes: The treatment proposed in the declared primary version of Attachment 5.

citations.finding: Version 2 names 13 projects that 'will continue as planned' and 14 projects that 'may be re-evaluated using alternate design approaches.' Its recommended approach calls for evaluating remaining routes and bringing a Q1 2027 report to Council for direction and approval.
citations.establishes: The two route lists, their counts and Version 2's stated treatment.

citations.finding: Version 2 says the remaining routes will be evaluated and a report will seek Council direction in Q1 2027, but does not state in terms that construction or advancement of every listed-apart route waits for that step.
citations.establishes: Why the primary express-deferral element is not established for the declared primary version.

items.title: Attachment 5 - IS03688 - Modified Approach (original)

citations.finding: The original Attachment 5 would remove the 14 listed routes from the programme's scope for 2026 and 2027, pending evaluation. That meets the deferral definition (and the strict one) under this version.
citations.establishes: Under the original version, a deferral of 14 named routes was recommended.
citations.quote: the following projects would be removed from the scope of the Active Transportation Network Expansion Program for 2026 and 2027. After Administration evaluates any applicable changes in municipal bike lane authority ... these routes may be revisited

citations.finding: The original Attachment 5 expressly says the 14 listed projects would be removed from programme scope for 2026 and 2027, with possible later reconsideration. Version 1 instead says listed projects may be revisited and uses a conditional removal rule based on travel-lane or parking impacts.
citations.establishes: The material difference between the original treatment and the replacement versions.

items.title: IS03688 and Replacement (Version 2) Attachment 5, DocumentId 304030

citations.finding: The report recommends Council approval of the updated approach in Attachment 5. It says Council approval is required for a modified direction. Version 2 says remaining routes will be evaluated and that a Q1 2027 report will seek Council direction and approval; it does not say the listed routes must await that report before construction or advancement.
citations.establishes: R’s text and the distinction between re-evaluation and an express deferral under the brief’s definition.
citations.quote: The remaining routes will be evaluated for trade-offs, alternative design treatments and budget implications. In Q1 2027, Administration will bring forward a report ... for Council direction and approval.

citations.finding: The report says construction on routes where it had not started is best postponed to 2027, and Version 2 schedules a Q1 2027 report. Those passages support a slower schedule but do not expressly state that construction or advancement of the listed routes waits until that evaluation, report or decision.
citations.establishes: The report’s postponement language is not an express link between the listed routes and a later evaluation or Council decision as required by the fixed definition.
citations.quote: Realistically, for routes where construction has not yet started, construction is best postponed to 2027.

citations.finding: Version 2’s operative wording says the remaining routes will be evaluated and that 14 listed projects may be re-evaluated; it does not say they cannot be constructed or advanced pending that evaluation or the Q1 2027 report. Its list uses “may be re-evaluated,” while the report’s Q1 report passage outlines trade-offs and options for Council direction and approval without expressly saying the routes wait for it.
citations.establishes: The exact express-deferral condition in the normalized proposition is not met by Version 2’s text.
citations.quote: The remaining routes will be evaluated for trade-offs, alternative design treatments and budget implications.

citations.quote: If Council approves the approach, the following projects may be re-evaluated using alternate design approaches.

items.title: Original Attachment 5, DocumentId 304032; Replacement Version 1, DocumentId 304031; Replacement Version 2, DocumentId 304030

citations.finding: Original Attachment 5 has 14 entries in its reevaluation list and says they would be removed from programme scope for 2026 and 2027, with possible reconsideration after administration evaluates anticipated legislative changes and funding. Version 1 also has 14 entries, but says they may be revisited using alternative designs or future initiatives. Version 2 has 14 entries and says they may be re-evaluated.
citations.establishes: The three versions differ in the force of their wording; all list 14 entries for potential reconsideration, and only the original expressly states removal from programme scope for a stated period.
citations.quote: If Council approves the recommended change in approach, the following projects would be removed from the scope ... for 2026 and 2027.
